plugin.note: Kurasks have the leafy attribute and can only be damaged by leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart. Protect from Melee is simplest; Bones to Peaches is viable with 75 Defence.

requirements: 70 Slayer and 65 combat are required for Kurask assignments.
Use only leaf-bladed weapons, broad-tipped ammunition, or Magic Dart for damage.
Bigger and Badder unlocks King kurask superior spawns.
Iorwerth Dungeon requires Song of the Elves.
Kurask Lair requires 58 Sailing to dock on Laguna Aurorae for the first time.
Bones to Peaches requires the Mage Training Arena unlock.
mechanics: Kurasks attack with crush and can hit up to 11.
Protect from Melee negates all normal Kurask damage.
With at least 75 Defence, players can skip prayer and use Bones to Peaches for lower-cost sustain.
King kurask has no special mechanics, but is more accurate and has a max hit of 33.
Kurasks are weakest to stab, ranged, and magic attacks.
The leafy attribute restricts damage to leaf-bladed weapons, broad-tipped ammunition, or Magic Dart.
Cannons and Thralls do not deal damage to Kurasks.
Saradomin godsword, Ancient godsword, and Toxic blowpipe special attacks can still heal as if their rolled damage landed.
Ancient mace and Eldritch nightmare staff special attacks can restore Prayer based on rolled damage.
Guthan's equipment set effect does not activate against Kurasks.
Kurasks have fast health regeneration, healing 1 Hitpoint every five game ticks.
Kurasks have a small aggressive range of 2 centered on their south-west tile.

methods.label: Damage restrictions
methods.summary: Respect the leafy damage restriction: only leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart can damage Kurasks.
steps: Equip a leaf-bladed weapon, a bow or crossbow using broad ammunition, or a Magic Dart setup.
Do not bring ordinary weapons or spells as the main damage source.
Cannons and Thralls can be present in some areas but will not damage Kurasks.
Use special attack weapons only for healing or Prayer restoration utility where their effects still trigger.
notes: The task page compares this restriction to Turoths.

methods.label: Leaf-bladed melee
methods.summary: Use leaf-bladed battleaxe for high melee damage, or leaf-bladed sword/spear when available as lower-tier alternatives.
steps: Use leaf-bladed battleaxe on slash or crush despite Kurasks being weakest to stab because the battleaxe has a much higher max hit.
Use leaf-bladed sword on stab if battleaxe is unavailable.
Pray Protect from Melee for the lowest-attention setup.
Bring a healing special attack weapon such as Saradomin godsword if extending trips.
notes: The task page says slash is still better with leaf-bladed battleaxe because the max hit advantage outweighs the slightly higher slash defence.

methods.label: Broad ammunition ranged
methods.summary: Use broad bolts or broad arrows with ranged gear when safespotting or training Ranged.
steps: Use broad bolts with a crossbow or broad arrows with a compatible bow.
Use the safespots in Fremennik Slayer Dungeon or Iorwerth Dungeon when desired.
Do not switch to non-broad ammunition because it will not damage Kurasks.
Use Toxic blowpipe only as a special attack healing option, not as the main damage source.
notes: The task page lists broad bolts and broad arrows as valid damage sources.

methods.label: Bones to Peaches sustain
methods.summary: At 75 Defence or higher, skip constant prayer and heal from Kurask bones with Bones to Peaches for cheaper trips.
requiredOrKeyItems: Nature runes and earth/water runes or tablets
At least one Prayer potion for King kurask
steps: Use this method only if the account has at least 75 Defence and can tolerate more attention.
Collect Kurask bones during the trip.
Cast Bones to Peaches when food is needed.
Turn on Protect from Melee if a King kurask spawns.
Bring at least one Prayer potion in case the superior spawns.
risks: This method is more attention-intensive than camping Protect from Melee.
King kurask is much more accurate and can hit up to 33.

methods.label: King kurask superior
methods.summary: Handle King kurask as a stronger superior with no special mechanics, using Protect from Melee and a valid leafy damage source.
requiredOrKeyItems: Leaf-bladed battleaxe or valid broad/Magic Dart setup
steps: Turn on Protect from Melee when King kurask spawns, especially during a Bones to Peaches trip.
Continue using leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart.
Expect higher accuracy and a max hit of 33, but no additional mechanics.
In Iorwerth Dungeon, pick up the guaranteed Crystal shards from King kurasks.
notes: King kurask superior drops roll additional items from the regular counterpart's table.

methods.label: Location choice
methods.summary: Choose Fremennik for baseline access, Iorwerth for crystal shards after Song of the Elves, or Kurask Lair for tighter clumps after 58 Sailing.
requiredOrKeyItems: Song of the Elves for Iorwerth Dungeon
58 Sailing for first Kurask Lair dock
steps: Use Fremennik Slayer Dungeon for standard access and its task-only area.
Use Iorwerth Dungeon after Song of the Elves when crystal shards matter.
Use Kurask Lair after 58 Sailing when tighter spawns and Laguna Aurorae access are preferred.
Remember that cannon damage does not work in any Kurask location.
notes: Kurask Lair becomes more convenient after speaking to the island spirit tree.

methods.label: Inventory and loot
methods.summary: Bring trip-extension tools and loot storage because Kurasks are a profitable task with alchables, herbs, seeds, and noted supplies.
requiredOrKeyItems: Bones to Peaches runes or tablets
Ring of wealth for automatic coin pickup
inventory: Leaf-bladed battleaxe or broad ammunition setup
Bones to Peaches runes or tablets
Optional Saradomin godsword, Ancient godsword, Toxic blowpipe, Ancient mace, or Eldritch nightmare staff for special attack utility
steps: Bring an Herb sack because Kurasks drop three herbs at a time when they roll the herb table.
Bring High Alchemy runes for frequent alchable weapons and armour.
Pick up coins, Nature runes, seeds, white berries, big bones, coconuts, and papaya fruit as desired.
Use Iorwerth Dungeon for Crystal shard value, with guaranteed Crystal shards from King kurasks there.
notes: Kurasks can drop leaf-bladed sword, mystic robe top (light), leaf-bladed battleaxe, hard clue scrolls, and Kurask heads.

styleOptions.summary: Primary melee setup using leaf-bladed battleaxe.

styleOptions.summary: Ranged setup using broad bolts or broad arrows.

styleOptions.summary: Magic option using Magic Dart, one of the few valid ways to damage Kurasks.

body:
# Kurask

Kurasks have the leafy attribute and can only be damaged by leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or Magic Dart. Use leaf-bladed battleaxe melee, broad ammunition ranged, or Magic Dart; Protect from Melee is simplest, while 75 Defence accounts can sustain with Bones to Peaches. Cannons and Thralls do not damage Kurasks.
